name: Ruthless Dropweight
description: Opens the exchange with one wide arc of the weight at head height to claim the space.

name: Unmoving Weightneck
description: Catches a descending blade on the stiffened cord and shears it away down the rope.

name: Veering Weighttip
description: Shuffles wide around the line of a thrust and cuts back in behind the weapon.

name: Cableslap
description: Arcs the weight over a raised guard so that it hooks down on the unprotected collar.

name: Pondererscreen
description: Stretches the cord across the back of the neck and presses forward until the foe stoops.

name: Binding Slingshot
description: Whips the cord upward under a lifted weapon and swats it out of line.

name: Cablescorer
description: Drives the weight in a great flat orbit with qi in the iron that strikes every foe at the edge.

name: Cableswat
description: Steps through an attacker's line and swings the qi-charged weight into the exposed flank.

name: Unmoving Tailstone
description: Opens with a steady whirl of the weight before the body that turns cuts and thrusts alike.

name: Ropehead Carapace
description: Whips a turn of cord about the forearm and pulls the weapon hand toward the body.

name: Whorlslap
description: Reverses the whirl in a single beat and cracks the weight against the foe's back guard.

name: Gyrebarrier
description: Flicks the end of the cord at the hilt hand so the grip slackens for a heartbeat.

name: Lithe Meteorhead
description: Turns on one foot like a swinging door while the whirl follows and shields the retreat.

name: Gagging Cordsplice
description: Winds the whirling cord around the length of a blade and locks it so it cannot be drawn back.

name: Entangling Spinout
description: Pins the bound weapon arm to the opponent's body with the cord and drives the weight into the side.

name: Pondererslap
description: Casts the weight to the end of the rope and strikes a foe outside sword length.

name: Brassponderer
description: Gathers the loose rope into the hand as the weight returns and shields the chest as it lands.

name: Clay Revolve
description: Sweeps the weight in a wide circle at knee height and forces every foe to hop or fall.

name: Brawn Plummet
description: Pays out two arm-lengths of rope and takes two paces to hold the foe at the cord's end.

name: Mirage Longrope
description: Snaps the weight past the foe's face at the exact edge of reach so he hesitates.

name: Levering Reelback
description: Hitches the far end of the cord on a post or limb and hauls with the whole body.

name: Ember Loopend
description: Swings the long rope in a ceaseless orbit with qi along it that clears several attackers at once.

name: Brassgyre
description: Hurls the weight high and hauls it down on a distant foe with a hard pull of the whole arm.

name: Momentplumb
description: Keeps the heavy weight crossing every lane of approach so that no foe can close.

name: Whorlflog
description: Chokes the rope short in the fist and jabs the weight out with the elbow behind it.

name: Stalwart Loopend
description: Slaps the short cord across a forearm strike from inside and turns it off the body.

name: Ruthless Plummet
description: Winds the cord about the knuckles so the weight lands as a hammer fist on the jaw.

name: Gyre Hasp
description: Slips the cord over the head in a clinch and cinches it across the throat.

name: Wild Weightneck
description: Packs a pulse of qi into the choked fist and lets the weight hit through a raised guard.

name: Plumbhasp
description: Rolls the short weight tight about the forearm in a qi-hardened shell that turns a heavy strike.

name: Brawn Dropweight
description: Opens with a slow lazy swing that sets the foe's timing to the wrong beat.

name: Honed Cordsplice
description: Breaks the slow beat with a sudden crack of the weight at the head.

name: Haze Gyre
description: Pauses the weight mid-flight at half length so the foe over-commits to a counter.

name: Armored Meteorhead
description: Sways the arm in an even count that keeps the weight a moving screen before the body.

name: Revolve Zip
description: Reels the cord in at twice its pace while closing the gap behind the returning weight.

name: Spriggyre
description: Drops the beat and snares the lead ankle as the foe steps into the empty rhythm.

name: Draught Orbitband
description: Shifts the length of the cord to meet a cut at its weakest point and turn it.

name: Clay Ropehead
description: Runs the weight through three strokes in uneven tempo that no single parry can answer.

name: Slingshot Slap
description: Snaps the cord with qi so that the weight leaps a full arm past the expected reach.

name: Gallwhorl
description: Cracks the cord in the foe's counted rhythm and spoils his next beat of attack.

name: Fierce Spinout
description: Skims the weight along the floor and lifts it as it meets the foe's feet.

name: Raw Reelback
description: Drags the weight up a wall or post to rake the foe standing beside it.

name: Viselike Orbitband
description: Snags a cloak or sleeve with the dragged weight and hauls the wearer off balance.

name: Cablestalk
description: Backsteps with the weight trailing low so a pursuer trips on the cord.

name: Whorlprop
description: Lets the weight skid at the feet to block a low strike with its bulk.

name: Gripping Weighttip
description: Drags the cord across the bare wrist and burns the grip loose.

name: Longrope Slap
description: Drives the weight through the dirt in a qi-driven furrow and rises into the foe's chest.

name: Entangling Meteorhead
description: Sweeps the cord and weight through loose dirt and blinds the foe just before the strike lands.

name: Lassoing Weighttip
description: Hooks a looped cord behind the ankle and tugs it forward to unseat the foe.

name: Lassoing Weightneck
description: Lassoes the shaft of a spear and rides the cord to pull its point off line.

name: Poise Tailstone
description: Catches an overarm blade on the cord and returns the weight into the attacker's arm.

name: Gallgyre
description: Loops the cord round the elbow and jerks it to spoil the angle of a cut.

name: Lithe Revolve
description: Releases the hooked cord in an instant and steps clear before the foe can pull back.

name: Keen Dropweight
description: Catches the foe's thrown pole on the cord and flings it back with the weight behind.

name: Splice Cordsplice
description: Hooks a limb and sends a shudder of qi down the cord that wrenches the joint.

name: Viselike Longrope
description: Hooks the weapon hand with a flick and pulls it from the foe like a hooked fish.

name: Acrid Slingshot
description: Catches a blow on the cord then reverses the weight along the same line into the attacker.

name: Genial Ropehead
description: Pulses qi down the cord to read the weight's balance and the slack before each throw.

name: Regimen Loopend
description: Cradles the returning weight on the wrist and uses the arm to shield the ribs.

name: Whorlscorer
description: Snaps the weight along a straight line to the face with all of the cord running true.

name: Orbitband Buckle
description: Twists a slack turn out of the cord in the middle of a swing and flicks it at the foe's eyes.

name: Whorlswerve
description: Slips sideways on the practice mark while the weight stays on the same straight line.

name: Buffering Tailstone
description: Steadies the cord with a thread of qi so each orbit closes exactly on the hand and shields the body.

name: Fierce Reelback
description: Spins the cord into a taut spiral that drives the weight through a guard in a straight line.
